verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a banking-API SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents letting customers choose where their data is stored. The community note that accounts are held at partner banks concerns where funds are custodied, not a user-selectable data residency option, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
